==Hero Usage==
Heroes cast this on recharge on allies that are moving and do not already have this effect, but will not cast on themselves unless the player forces them to.

== Notes ==
{{anomaly|Unlike the descriptions of other Echo skills, this skill's descriptions do not mention that it cannot target [[spirit]]s.}}
